data.description_en:
Wheat Wrap (Externally Sourced) 🌾

Product type: Wheat wrap (externally supplied) 🌾

Net weight: 774g ⚖️

Origin: See supplier ingredient information

WRAP NOTICE ⚠️

The wrap used in this product is not made in-house by Roots.

We are currently using a commercially available wheat wrap so this product can continue to be produced and enjoyed.

The ingredient standard of this wrap does not fully align with our usual Roots principles, and we want to be transparent about that.

This is a temporary solution while we develop a cleaner, more Roots-aligned alternative.

When a better option is ready, this component will be upgraded.

INGREDIENTS (Wrap) 🧾

Wheat flour, water, whole wheat flour, shortening (palm oil), salt, white sugar, wheat gluten, compound leavening agents (disodium dihydrogen pyrophosphate, sodium bicarbonate, potassium bicarbonate, tapioca starch), guar gum, calcium propionate, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), sodium bicarbonate, fumaric acid, mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids, yeast
data.description_cn:
小麦卷饼（外部供应）🌾

产品类型：小麦卷饼（外部供应）🌾

净含量：774g ⚖️

产地：见供应商配料信息

饼皮说明 ⚠️

本产品所使用的卷饼皮并非 Roots 自制。

目前采用市售小麦卷饼，是为了确保该产品能够持续生产与供应。

该饼皮的配料标准与我们一贯的 Roots 自制标准并不完全一致，我们对此保持透明说明。

这是阶段性的解决方案，我们正在研发更干净、更符合 Roots 标准的替代产品。

一旦升级完成，将会替换使用。

配料表（卷饼皮）🧾

小麦粉、水、全麦粉、起酥油（棕榈油）、盐、白砂糖、小麦面筋、复合膨松剂（焦磷酸二氢二钠、碳酸氢钠、碳酸氢钾、木薯淀粉）、瓜尔胶、丙酸钙、羧甲基纤维素钠（CMC）、碳酸氢钠、富马酸、脂肪酸单、双甘油酯、酵母
